grep -o "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/types/* 2>/dev/null | head

ls /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/ && grep -l "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts; grep -o "ViewTransition[A-Za-z]*" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | sort -u | head; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json

head -35 /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && grep -n "export const ViewTransition\|function ViewTransition\|ViewTransition:" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head; ls /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null && cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts
